## Gates

- [ ] Spec approved by @
- [ ] Tests approved by @ (fail for the right reason)
- [ ] Code approved by @ (all tests green)
- [ ] Change archived (`openspec/specs/` updated)
- [ ] Final review by a code owner (not the author)
- [ ] Merged
